verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch3.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); UN M49 South-eastern Asia membership as listed in World Population Prospects 2024
verification.result: All 2,914 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; build-time assertions caught one wrong comparison (Singapore, not Thailand, is South-eastern Asia's second-largest economy) and the Russia Dataset coverage was corrected to start in 1988 before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
